{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or shows early negative signals.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% when recent history shows strong upward spikes followed by sharp declines.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 10-15%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive (sentiment = 0).",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early forecast periods — especially when history shows volatility or downward momentum.",
    "If sentiment is positive and forecast is below 5% of recent 30-day low, increase by 5-8% to align with sentiment momentum.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is significantly below forecast, adjust next forecast downward by 3-5% to account for delayed reaction."
  ]
}
